resolutions.resolution_route_used: UniProt P09615 Ser239 palmitoleoylation/Notum state vs FlyBase-linked Wnt/Wg literature (OpenAlex)
resolutions.evidence: Porcupine-mediated Wnt lipidation is required for Wnt secretion/recognition ('Porcupine-mediated lipidation is required for Wnt recognition by Wls', 2011, doi:10.1016/j.ydbio.2011.11.003), and UniProt annotates Wg Ser239 O-palmitoleoylation by PORCN with Notum depalmitoleoylation inhibiting signalling. Literature direction matches the registered prediction: lipidation loss contracts Wg distribution/target range toward producing cells.

resolutions.resolution_route_used: UniProt Q02936 N-product/dual lipidation state vs wing-disc Hh literature (OpenAlex)
resolutions.evidence: The signalling species is the dually lipid-modified N-product, whose release/spread is a regulated, tethered process ('Scube/You activity mediates release of dually lipid-modified Hedgehog signal', 2012, doi:10.1101/gad.191866.112; gradient-travel review doi:10.1101/gad.1233104). This matches the registered claim that the 173 aa lipidated N-product (not the 471 aa precursor) is the active, range-limited species; unmodified HhN is the standard farther-spreading/lower-peak comparator in this literature.

resolutions.resolution_route_used: Dataset clock-wavefront assignment vs established Drosophila long-germ segmentation literature
resolutions.evidence: Negative prediction holds: Drosophila blastoderm segmentation is long-germ — pair-rule stripes are specified near-simultaneously by gap-gene inputs, with no travelling Hes/her segmentation-clock wavefront laying down stripes sequentially by S=u*T. No source describes a Drosophila blastoderm clock wavefront; the dataset's clock_wavefront assignment for Drosophila is a mechanism mis-assignment, as registered.
resolutions.resolvability_verdict: as_predicted — current_plus_public_sources (conf 0.90): decidable from established embryology.

resolutions.resolution_route_used: Dataset Murray law vs Drosophila tracheal morphometry literature search (OpenAlex)
resolutions.evidence: Bound established: insect tracheal systems are not generically Murray-optimal (ant tracheal branching violates network-transport assumptions, doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1007853; Murray compliance varies by insect system, doi:10.1186/s12915-021-01130-0), consistent with the negative prediction. NOT established: a Drosophila tracheal parent/daughter diameter series sufficient to fit an exponent against the registered 2.8-3.2 band. Missing data: tabulated Drosophila tracheal diameters across branch orders.
resolutions.resolvability_verdict: as_predicted — registered partial_only (conf 0.45); bounded, not decided, as forecast.
